title: I'm implementing LLM AI Players in my game. You will be able to interact with them as real players, I tested and had lots of fun with it while playing check it out! It's not perfect yet but has already really advanced features, let me know your thoughts! Read the comments...
author: AetherianChronicles

comments.author: AetherianChronicles
comments.body:
We want to hear the gamers' opinions about the generative AI in the game, it's really important the feedback and support as we are a small team and working on a big game idea. The AI it's not perfect yet but it's pretty solid already, you can directly chat with them, team up, do quests, and grind together, they remember you and the things you've done. It takes a lot of work and money but with hard work, we are getting solid results. If you liked the video and you want to play the game our first demo will be open to everyone, sign in to our list. We will send you updates and the link to play the game when we release it, It would mean a lot to us: [https://aetherianchronicles.com/](https://aetherianchronicles.com/)

From over a year developing Aetherian Chronicles to finally releasing our first demo, we can't say how excited we are!! The demo will be out in March. We are a small team of experienced developers with a small budget, so we need the support of those interested, our goal is to make this game a long-life MMO. The name of the game is Aetherian Chronicles, which is a 3D sidescroller with 15+ maps now ( our plan is to get funding and add more maps later ). You can explore the maps, kill monsters, do quests, and grind with your friends. Meet new people in a cute environment heavily inspired by the best ideas of Maplestory. We are going to open a discord next month and we can notify you when it's open, you can see more of our [game here](https://x.com/KFishPlatforms/status/1874899473648001386).

comments.author: MrMiichou
comments.body:
Hey, first of all nice job ! 
if you can talk about about it,
I was wondering what kind of LLM you are using ? Do you use a custom model ? Or a solution like Chagpt or Claude ? 
Did you have feedback of the community of the usage of LLM   ? As a touchy subject is it accept with the community? Are you using IA in other aspects?

Thanks for the response! Good luck !

replies.author: AetherianChronicles
replies.body:
Hi Mrmiichou, we use Chagpt-4. We don't have community feedback in the usage of the AI yet, we are counting on gamers and devs interested in joining our discord server and playing together with us to get feedback and get more data.

It is a touchy subject considering many people hate on AI in general and the number of misinformation out there about it. We only use the AI as players, our NPCs are not with AI and the game is fully developed with out AI tools.

replies.author: MrMiichou
replies.body:
Thanks for the sharing ! 

Last questions was it hard to implement ? Did it require you a specific work around to implement the solution  ?  
  
I will give it a try when I will have some time ! Some colleagues/friends are curious about it, I think they gonna try it to see the experience !
